home.title: Turn agricultural waste into valuable resources.
home.subtitle: Discover, buy, and sell agricultural by-products through Bangladesh’s growing circular economy marketplace.
home.discoveryTitle: A better way to source local materials.
home.discoveryText: Explore sample supply areas and discover agricultural by-products across Bangladesh.
home.producerText: Connect farm, mill, and processing residues with businesses looking for practical local supply.
home.buyerTitle: Find the right material for your business.
home.buyerText: Compare available materials by type, quantity, price, location, condition, and supply schedule.
home.freshText: A selection of recent sample listings from producers around the country.
home.priceDisclaimer: Prices and availability are illustrative demo data, not verified market quotations.
home.requestTitle: Searching for a material that isn’t listed?
home.requestText: See what businesses are sourcing or post a requirement of your own.
home.processTitle: A simple path from supply to use.
home.processText: Notunayon helps people find one another. Buyers and sellers agree on the details directly.
home.matchingText: Explore suppliers based on material fit, location, available quantity, listed price, and condition. Recommendations are a frontend demonstration—not a live AI service.
home.sourcingTitle: Need help sourcing for your business?
home.sourcingText: Share what your team is looking for. Our sourcing request demo helps organize your material, volume, and delivery needs.
home.logisticsTitle: Local logistics can connect supply with demand.
home.logisticsText: Transport providers can support collection, consolidation, and delivery between agricultural producers and material buyers.
home.impactEyebrow: An early-stage idea with room to grow
home.impactTitle: Better use starts with better connections.
home.impactText: Illustrative demonstration figures for this frontend prototype.

chatbot.name: Tonu AI
chatbot.subtitle: Your Notunayon Marketplace Assistant
chatbot.demoNote: Responses are predefined demonstrations. No AI service is connected.
chatbot.enterHint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
chatbot.welcome: Hello! I'm Tonu AI, your Notunayon assistant. I can help you discover agricultural materials, find suppliers, understand by-products, and navigate our marketplace. How can I help you today?
chatbot.welcomeBn: হ্যালো! আমি টোনু AI, আপনার Notunayon সহকারী। কৃষিজ উপকরণ খুঁজে পাওয়া, বিক্রেতা খোঁজা, উপ-বর্জ্য সম্পর্কে জানা এবং মার্কেটপ্লেসে নেভিগেট করতে আমি আপনাকে সাহায্য করতে পারি। আজ কীভাবে সাহায্য করতে পারি?
chatbot.s2: How can I sell cattle manure?
chatbot.s3: What is poultry litter used for?
